# UI/UX Skill

This skill provides guidance for improving UI/UX, accessibility, responsive layouts, and design consistency in the Booking App.

## Purpose
- Review front-end components for usability issues.
- Recommend accessible interactions and layout improvements.
- Suggest Tailwind utility class usage and semantic markup.

## Usage
- Use the `.copilot/skills-manifest.json` manifest to register the skill.
- Reference the `docs/skills/skill-request-template.md` template to create consistent prompts.
- Use `docs/skills/ui-ux-checklist.md` to track implementation.
